description: Get comments on a task, list, or view. context_type defaults to 'task'. Requires task name/ID for task context, list_id/list_name for list context, view_id for view context.

include_replies.description: Include threaded replies inline for each comment.

listName.description: List name. Helps resolve duplicate task names.

list_id.description: List ID. Required when context_type is 'list'.

list_name.description: List name (auto-resolved). Used when context_type is 'list'.

task.description: Task name or ID. Required when context_type is 'task' (default).

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

view_id.description: View ID. Required when context_type is 'view'.

name: get_comments
